messages:
alyssa: heads up — CI flagged microbench regression on PR #20501: kv_cache_hitrate dropped -5.8% (threshold -1%). job: https://ci.internal/redwood/24567 :cry:
cheng: ugh. which benchmark exactly? can you paste the diff?
alyssa: snippet from CI failure:
```
Benchmark: kv_cache_hitrate
Baseline: 0.932
Current: 0.878  <-- -5.8%
Threshold: -1%
```
Link to logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/24567/artifacts/kv_hit.log
sam: quick glance at the flame graph in the artifacts — big spike in kernel_selector.cpp on fallback path. looks like autoselect picked an int8 concat kernel for short sequences and it's thrashing kv cache.
maria: that matches telemetry I saw on the shadow cluster — increased KV evictions when small-batch kernel is chosen. batching heuristic now biases for low-latency small-window kernels; might be starving prefetch/kv warmup.
cheng: trying to reproduce locally: docker image rwinf-ci:perf-2026-03-20, running ./ci/run_microbench --bench=kv_cache_hitrate --runs=20
(after a few minutes) cheng: repro'd on p2-small. profile cmd: `perf record -g -- ./microbench --bench kv_cache_hitrate`
sam: can you dump the automodel cost table? suspect commit abc1234 from PR #20312 bumped some kernel cost weights.
cheng: pulled history, bisect points to commit abc1234 (2026-03-18) — it changed kernel-cost-model.json:
```
- "int8_concat": { "cost_factor": 0.9 }
+ "int8_concat": { "cost_factor": 1.3 }
```
cheng: reverting that locally makes the microbench return to within +0.1% of baseline.
alyssa: ok that's our prime suspect. is that change safe to revert? it was intended for some long-seq throughput wins.
maria: the change improved some long-tail throughput but didn't account for short-seq KV-warmup behavior. rollout should have been canaryed.
sam: short-term plan: revert the cost bump in kernel-cost-model in a hotfix PR, add a unit test that exercises short-sequence kv warmup path and asserts no >2% regression, and add a microbench that measures KV hitrate under seqlen=8 distribution. I'll open PR 'fix/20501-revert-kcost-warmup'.
alyssa: filing rollback PR now. tagging @cheng @maria for review. this is a rollout-blocker for PR #20501 — hold merge until hotfix lands.
dev-bot: new PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/20641 — title: fix(kernels): revert int8_concat cost bump + add kv warmup test
oncall-bot: kickstarting CI for PR 20641 (job 24590).
(oncall-bot later) oncall-bot: CI job 24590 passed microbench suite; kv_cache_hitrate now within +0.2% of baseline.
cheng: re-ran full CI on the original PR with the hotfix merged to main — results: all perf unit tests green.
sam: follow-up actions: (1) add a shadow-run metric that tracks kv_cache_hitrate for kernel-cost changes, (2) update rollout docs to require microbench coverage for kernel cost edits, (3) add a metric to the console to alert on KV eviction spikes during canary.
maria: +1 to all. I'll file the follow-ups.
alyssa: thanks everyone. marking PR #20501 as blocked until hotfix lands (now fixed) — will proceed with merge after post-merge monitoring window. :thumbsup:
